summary: Full backend + frontend end-to-end testing for Bergslagsleden Ultra companion app. 12/12 pytest backend tests pass covering config, auth (good/bad login, /me guard, cookie auth), registration (create, validation, invalid distance, missing fields, auto-bib-increment), startlist grouping, admin lookup (valid/invalid bib), admin finish-time entry (valid/invalid format, invalid bib), results sorting (asc by finish_seconds, rank assignment). Frontend Playwright flow validated: landing loads, /anmalan distance selection toggles addons-47km correctly, missing-addon validation triggers toast, successful 47km registration shows success screen with assigned bib number, startlist shows new runner in 47km tab, admin login rejects wrong password + accepts correct credentials + redirects to /admin, bib lookup auto-populates name/club, finish-time submission works, /resultat displays runner with correct time under proper distance tab with rank ordering visible (rank 1 highlighted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS uses only FRONTEND_URL env (single origin) with allow_credentials=True — correct for prod; the CORS_ORIGINS env var in backend/.env is defined but unused (dead config).

send_confirmation_email is awaited inline in POST /api/registrations; if Resend is slow it delays the response. Consider fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task to keep registration snappy (currently non-blocking on failure but still awaited on success path).
parse_time_to_seconds is called twice inside admin_finish (once via normalize_time, once directly) — minor duplicate parse, harmless.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout expectation). Not implemented; acceptable for MVP but worth flagging.
next_bib_number is not atomic (race condition possible under concurrent registrations). Consider using a MongoDB counters collection with findOneAndUpdate($inc) for safety.

Radio option labels use very long strings (e.g. 'JA - jag vill ha en medalj efter målgång.') as the stored value; this makes the DB coupled to UI copy. Store an enum ('yes_medal'/'no_medal') and render the label in UI/email instead.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_ prefixed registrations then clean them up via DELETE /api/admin/registrations/{bib}. Frontend flow created one 'UITEST_Runner_<ts>' registration (bib=3, distance=47km, finish=04:15:30) which was left in the DB for visual verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be reused (uses pytest, JUnit XML output). Auth uses httpOnly cookie samesite=none secure=true — requests.Session handles cookies automatically; browser tests must use the external HTTPS URL (not localhost) for cookies to flow. Frontend leaves one leftover UITEST_Runner registration in DB with finish time recorded, safe to delete if needed. The 401 console errors on public pages are benign — they come from the auth-context checking /api/auth/me on every route.
